lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr6Ga6Ni4 (reduced formula Zr3Ga3Ni2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216) with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows all three elements adopt 12-neighbor, close-packed-like local arrangements: Ga and Ni are surrounded by 6 Ga, 2 Ni, and 4 Zr neighbors, while Zr has 8 Ga and 4 Ni neighbors, with neighbor distances from 2.7422 to 3.1651 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and spans all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Ga-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Ga and Ni polyhedra.
